Backend fix confirmed via curl: 1st DELETE → reversed=true, posted=true, journal_id issued; 2nd DELETE → success=true with idempotent=true and message 'القيد مَعكوس مسبقًا — لا حاجة لإجراء إضافي'. No TypeError. TEST B: UI delete flow end-to-end — logged in مدير/010101, navigated to /accounting/journal-entries, clicked journal-mode-full-button, located the disposable card (search by nonce did not filter — see minor issue below; used scroll instead), opened '•••', clicked 'إلغاء القيد (عكسي)', confirmed modal title 'إلغاء القيد بقيد عكسي', clicked confirm-delete-btn, captured native alert 'تم إلغاء أثر القيد بنجاح عبر قيد عكسي من المحرك المحاسبي', and after refresh saw the amber reversal card ('قيد عكسي' tag, JE-0002) next to the original amber card (JE-0001, 'قيد اختبار مؤقت للحذف العكسي UI') — audit trail preserved. TEST C: /accounting/comprehensive → financial-close-period-button opens the dialog with 'تاريخ الإقفال: 2026-08-17' (today's server date, NOT 2099-12-31) → cancelled with Escape without confirming (no closing entry posted).

minor.issue: Route wraps engine result in success:true whether reversed=true or reversed=false+idempotent=true. Both branches share the same top-level success flag, and the idempotent hint lives at data.entries[0].idempotent (not at data.idempotent) — worth surfacing at data root for easier client consumption; documented in test fix.

Idempotency: identical (date + lines) payloads across sessions return the SAME entry_id — description in DB does NOT update from the second POST even though HTTP 200 message says 'تم إنشاء القيد المحاسبي بنجاح'. Could mislead callers into thinking a new entry was created. Consider returning an 'existing:true' flag or updating description on repeat POST.

integration_issues.issue: Search box filtering (input[placeholder*='بحث برقم القيد أو الوصف أو العميل']) does NOT match on partial Latin/hex tokens inside Arabic descriptions — e.g., searching for the nonce '69b98d' contained in description 'قيد اختبار مؤقت للحذف العكسي UI 69b98d' returns 0 results, while Arabic substring 'اختبار مؤقت للحذف' also returns 0 in full mode (may only match reference-id or exact prefix). Non-blocking: users can still scroll to locate entries. Recommend making description search case-insensitive and substring-based across mixed scripts.

action_items: (optional) Expose idempotent/already_reversed flag at data root of DELETE response (currently only at data.entries[0].idempotent) to make client-side branching cleaner.
(optional) Fix journal-full-mode search to substring-match Arabic + Latin/hex fragments in description.
(optional) POST /finance/journal-entries idempotency: include 'existing:true' when returning a previously-created entry rather than 'تم إنشاء ... بنجاح'.

rca of the issue: Original iter353 bug (reverse_entry() got an unexpected keyword argument 'workshop_id') is fixed at routes_finance.py delete_journal_entry — the workshop_id kwarg was removed from the accounting_engine.reverse_entry(...) call; the frozen core signature accounting_engine.reverse_entry(*, journal_id, reference_id, reason, actor) is respected. Idempotency path now short-circuits with success:true + message 'القيد مَعكوس مسبقًا — لا حاجة لإجراء إضافي' when reference 'reversal::<id>' already exists, preventing duplicate reversals.
